_note: Final thesis item F2 - production programme and FMS design data. Programme = Kenzo's default (2026-11-15, editable). Machine prices, areas, power = REFERENCE ESTIMATES (European/Asian mid-range list prices 2025-26, +-30 %), to be replaced by quotations. Tool: fms_design.py. Guide: Doctor paper/59_final_fms_design.md.

programme._H_note: productive hours per month: 2 shifts x 7.5 h x 22 days = 330 h (thesis assumption)
programme._lot_note: production lot = about 1 day VC20, about 1 week per RB variant (sets the number of set-ups)
programme._u_note: planning ceiling on top of OEE: load <= machines x H x OEE x u_max (queueing reserve)
programme._material_note: castings + forgings + bought parts + tank/motor + packing + consumables + tools + energy per unit, REFERENCE ESTIMATE (VC20: tank 300 L ~200, motor 3 kW ~170, castings 48 kg ~100, pistons/rings/valves/bearings ~90, switch/valves/gauges ~110, drive ~50, small parts ~30, packing ~40, consumables/tools/energy ~70, scrap 4 %)
programme._variable_note: sales, marketing, distribution, freight, warranty, commission as share of price
programme._overhead_note: indirect staff (~80 x 1500), management, engineering, quality, admin, IT, utilities base load, insurance - REFERENCE ESTIMATE
programme._other_note: placeholders until items F3-F12 deliver their own BOM-based cost; REFERENCE ESTIMATES

machines._cols: price EUR, area m2 (incl. service area, chip conveyor), kW mean electrical, OEE, operators per machine (while running), setup min per lot, department

alt_factor._note: time on the alternative machine / time on the primary machine (design estimate)

hmc_cell._note: closed queueing network of the pallet cell: classes = fixture types; one visit = one product unit (tombstone with all faces)

FC.parts: Roots kit R01 + R02 + R03 (housing + head plates on one tombstone)

hmc_cell._transport_note: 2 moves x 0.5 min (rail shuttle or AGV between rack, load station, HMC)

monte_carlo._note: lognormal time factor per machine type (sigma 0.15 ~ +-25 % at 90 %), normal demand factor

layout._note: two rows of departments along a central AGV aisle (spine layout); department width = area*factor/row_depth

HMC.name: pallet rack + load stations inside the HMC cell

layout._unit_note: parts per transport unit (crate / pallet) by family; products move singly on the assembly-test-paint-pack line
layout._dock_note: truck unit loads per month at the dock wall (castings in foundry pallets, bought parts, finished products)
layout._alias_note: F3 decision (2026-11-15): one AS/RS aisle stores RAW castings and KIT machined parts at the dock -> department KIT merged into RAW
